# Prosper & Prolu

> Two self-hosted developer products from the same team.

## Prosper
Self-hosted AI game builder for 2D (Phaser) and 3D (three.js) web games. A brief is split into units, models write each unit, every unit is verified, and the merged game is played in a headless browser and repaired until it reaches play. 44 of 45 hand-built templates pass the play gate. Launching 20 October 2026.
- [Prosper](https://prolu.indevs.in/)
- [Build log](https://prospernwo.netlify.app)

## Prolu
Self-hosted governance for AI coding agents: Gate (verify AI-written code), Warrant (short-lived agent permissions), Ledger (hash-chained, offline-verifiable log), Harbour (crash-safe agent jobs with approval gates), Proof (signed evidence of data rights), Bench (evaluate coding agents on your own repo). Community edition free; Gate Team $200/developer/year.
- [Prolu](https://prolu.indevs.in/prolu/)
- [Downloads](https://prolu.indevs.in/download/)
- [Source on GitHub](https://github.com/Celaris-dev1)
